title: Refinance Term Schedule by Contract Age — Kestrel Advantage Balloon
content:
**Refinance term schedule.** The term over which the balloon of a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract is refinanced depends on the whole calendar months from the contract date to the refinance date, and never exceeds the tier's longest refinance term:

| Whole months from contract date to refinance date | Refinance term |
|---|---|
| At least 48 | The tier's longest refinance term less 12 and less one further month for each whole month in service at or beyond 48, month 48 itself counting as one, but never below 6 months |
| At least 36 but fewer than 48 | The tier's longest refinance term less 12 |
| Fewer than 36 | The tier's longest refinance term |

The tier's longest refinance term is the figure in the balloon refinance terms schedule. Whole calendar months from one date to another are complete each time the later date reaches the earlier date's day of the month, so a later date that falls earlier in its month (month-end included) leaves that month incomplete.

## Hypothetical cases (tier longest term 48 months)

| Whole months in service | Term |
|---|---|
| 35 | 48 |
| 36 | 36 |
| 47 | 36 |
| 48 | 48 less 12 less 1, that is 35 |
| 52 | 48 less 12 less 5, that is 31 |

*Floor (tier longest term 24 months):* at 60 months in service, 24 less 12 less 13 is below 6, so the term is 6 months.
